borough_departures = data.groupby('StartBorough')['Rental Id'].nunique()
borough_arrivals = data.groupby('EndBorough')['Rental Id'].nunique()
self_contained_trips = data[data['StartBorough'] == data['EndBorough']]['Rental Id'].nunique()
arrival_share = borough_arrivals / borough_arrivals.sum()
expected_self_contained_trips = borough_departures * arrival_share
self_containment_index = self_contained_trips / expected_self_contained_trips

# Handle missing values
